programs.description: Rajalakshmi, who leads a lonely life, adopts Solomon after he loses his parents in a car accident. Solomon tries to help Rajalakshmi solve several problems that come her way.
A rural town gets excited when the local panchayat leader decides to make electricity available in the village. However, issues erupt when these benefits give rise to a series of dire situations.
Venu, a lorry driver, tries to save the family of his late father's boss from an evil businessman. However, he ends up in a fix when he learns that the evil businessman is none other than his boss.
Keshava Menon and Madhavan Nair are best friends and business partners. When Keshava dies in an accident, his son Balan takes over the company and realises Madhavan's ulterior motives.
Kannan and Radha share a deep romantic bond that transcends eras and emotions. However, they must navigate various obstacles together as their timeless affection continues to grow.
48th Soorya Festival 2025
Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.
An intense rivalry ensues between two brothers after their daughters fall in love with their driver. However, things take a drastic turn after their rivalry becomes a matter of their family prestige.
Narayanan, who gets convicted for killing his father, returns from prison to his village and works selflessly for its people. However, his vengeful relatives create obstacles for him.
Priya is furious to learn that her alcoholic husband, Sathyanadhan, is in love with Neena. Things deteriorate further after she files for divorce and her family takes some foolish steps.
After a past incident, two powerful clans of Krishnapuram remain estranged until one day, a man with a mysterious past decides to bring the families together.
Dhurv encounters Harika at the airport and is immediately smitten by her. He decides to pursue her and makes her fall in love with him.
Vidyadharan, a clockmaker and widower, lives only for his daughter. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he kills a thug, whom he suspected of murdering a village girl.

Rajan, a policeman, goes after a powerful criminal but ends up losing his wife and is also left crippled. Soon, he becomes a jailer and recruits four vigilantes to trap the kingpin who ruined his life.
Sajna rejects the love of her college mate, Ameer, as she is already engaged to her cousin Anwar. However, Sajna's marriage with Anwar gets cancelled due to an unexpected turn of events.
Kannan and Radha share a deep romantic bond that transcends eras and emotions. However, they must navigate various obstacles together as their timeless affection continues to grow.
The passionate dream of becoming musicians comes to a standstill for a group of college students when their main singer falls in love.

An anthology of three stories. The first story involves a murder investigation, the second story is about a group of goons following a girl, the third involves five friends delivering a package.
Gopalakrishnan, a chef, escapes from his village to a city when his marriage gets ruined. Later, he falls in love with Radhika, but his happiness is short-lived as his past returns to haunt him.
When a family of four sets out on a road trip, they are accompanied by two girls on their way. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the girls is found dead.
Fate intertwines the lives of Nandan and Thara, two hearts mending from lost love, leading them to discover a second chance at happiness together.
